title: Persist pipeline instances and immutable attempt provenance
description: Track each deliverable through the existing backlog/artifact/check/approval systems. Record content fingerprints, tool versions, model/prompt/seed where available, exact reviewed outputs, metrics and work/wait/cost evidence. Keep private data local; hosted seed does not guarantee reproducibility. Redo adds an attempt rather than overwriting history.
acceptanceCriteria: Each stage attempt links exact upstream inputs and output artifact digests
Reruns retain all prior attempts and superseded approval evidence
Unknown cost/model seed is explicit and private prompts are not exposed in public/demo state
